label: JWT Auth
description: Gate a Route or Socket with signed identity tokens from an issuer that publishes a JWKS (BetterAuth, Clerk, Auth0, Firebase, any OIDC provider). The connection holds the issuer and JWKS address; a caller sends `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`, signature, issuer, expiry (and audience, when set) are checked, and `caller` carries the token's claims.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Audience
fields.placeholder: optional: the aud claim a token must carry

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into a Route or Socket's `auth`.
